title: [finding] `check-dts-closure.mjs` shares `check-dts-emitted`’s manifest criterion, so the post-build sweep is chunk-blind the same way
body:
Path: P? | 落地后残余 | `check-dts-closure.mjs` 与 `check-dts-emitted.mjs` 共用清单判据,对 chunk 声明同样盲

Filed by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat 3 (#18883, session `session_01HnRAeVTLJevtQ5iCPX6JSm`) out of the **#19402 / PR #19434** round, from that dev's own out-of-scope finding. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only — `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `check-dts-closure manifest criterion chunk-blind` · `post-build sweep declaration closure` · `declaredDeclarationPaths shared derivation` · `vanished declarations sweep chunks` · `built workspace declaration references`.

## The mechanism

`scripts/check-dts-closure.mjs` is the **post-build sweep** over the whole built workspace. It imports `declaredDeclarationPaths` / `missingDeclarations` from `scripts/check-dts-emitted.mjs`, so it inherits that guard's **manifest-declared** criterion — and is therefore blind to **chunk** declarations in exactly the same way the per-package guard was, one instant later over a wider tree.

## The measurement that makes it concrete

The same 2-chunk ablation that carried #19402 — moving `dist/view.zod-CIU5lVgU.d.ts` and `dist/object.zod-ThXvwL_J.d.ts` aside — leaves `check-dts-emitted` at **exit 0** ("34/34 declared declaration file(s) present") while the emission is provably incomplete. ⭐ **That sweep would pass the same ablation**, because it asks the same question of a bigger tree.

Measured on the #19402 round: 72 built packages swept, 「164/164 declared declaration file(s) present」.

## Why this is its own card and not #19402's remainder

#19402 was the **composition gap** between `check-dts-emitted` (manifest-declared surface) and `distIsStale()` (build inputs vs dist); PR #19434 closed it by adding the third reading — the transitive closure of the specifiers the emitted declarations themselves write — as a step of `packages/spec`'s build. This card is a **different instrument** with the same blind spot, and teaching it that reading would give the entire built closure the answer in one place, at the instant CI reads the built surface.

⚠️ ⛔ Not measured here: whether the closure derivation is affordable over 72 packages in the sweep's own budget. PR #19434's per-package run was 4.9 s on `packages/spec`.
